source_summary: Ink landscape with winter-bare trees at left and center, pale misted ground, a towering rocky cliff at right, a small robed scholar below it, and sparse foreground banks with reeds, stones, and water lines. Calligraphy and seals are excluded.

motifs.name: left_windswept_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the far-left bare, windswept tree with twisting vertical trunk, cropped side branches, and angular ink limbs reaching into the open mist.
must_preserve: soft gray wash around the trunk

motifs.name: central_gnarled_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense central cluster of gnarled bare trunks and interlaced branches, including the dark main trunk, lighter companion stems, and root area.
must_preserve: layered black and gray trunk strokes

motifs.name: diagonal_foreground_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the large diagonal foreground tree rising from the lower center and splitting into long bare limbs that stretch toward the upper right.

motifs.name: midground_leafless_shrub
motifs.description: Isolate the small leafless shrub in the mid-right open space, with a low trunk and delicate horizontal branches against the pale mist.

motifs.name: under_cliff_low_shrub
motifs.description: Isolate the low spreading shrub beneath the cliff overhang, with gray-brown sweeping branches fanning left and right near the base of the rock.

motifs.name: overhanging_mossy_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the suspended rocky overhang on the upper right, including its rounded lower lobes, vertical wash textures, and clusters of dark moss dots.
must_preserve: soft pale edges fading into mist

motifs.name: right_vertical_cliff_wall
motifs.description: Isolate the tall vertical cliff wall at the far right, from the pale upper rock face down to the darker lower base and edge stones.
must_preserve: base rocks and rough ground texture

motifs.name: standing_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the small standing robed scholar near the lower right, facing left beneath the cliff with hands gathered and a dark hair cap or topknot.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
